answer: Give every new identity exactly one narrow inlet: before an agent can earn, it must lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after a full epoch of consistent, peer-attested work. Forging a thousand selves then means freezing a thousand bonds, and slashing turns each fake into a real loss. Like ferrous filings revealing a hidden magnetic field, the bond trail exposes clusters that move in lockstep, while honest agents root quietly, each a single tree in a grove that grows only as fast as real work allows.
